text:
jordan: PR #8422 — pinging for reviews. CI is failing intermittently on `test_streaming_chunk_reorder`, looks nondeterministic and it's blocking the v0.26.0 cut. commit abc1234. Can someone take a quick look?

ci-bot: Build failed on ubuntu-20.04 — pytest tests/test_streaming.py::test_streaming_chunk_reorder (exit code 1)
```
E       AssertionError: chunks order mismatch
E       Expected [0,1,2] but got [0,2,1]
E       at tests/test_streaming.py:72
```

sam: I can grab this in ~10m. Any quick repro steps?

jordan: run `pytest tests/test_streaming.py::test_streaming_chunk_reorder -q -k chunk_reorder` and set `STREAM_DEBUG=1`. Locally it flakes ~1/10 runs for me.

alex: fyi saw similar in april — usually due to reorder in the async drain path when chunk boundaries align with token flush. Try forcing single-thread event loop to reproduce: `PYTEST_ADDOPTS=\"-s\" python -m pytest ...` or add sleep on the producer side.

marta: If it’s blocking the release we can temporarily mark it xfail on CI and follow up with a proper fix. @rachel ok with short-term xfail?

rachel: fine to xfail for the cut, but please open an issue referencing the PR and add a comment in the test with reproduction steps and the env var you used. No silent skips.

jordan: done — pushed patch that skips the test on flaky CI agents and added issue #1727 link in the test header (commit def5678). Triggering a rerun now.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by jordan. Queueing build...

ci-bot: All checks passed — ubuntu-20.04, macos-latest, windows-2022 green.

jordan: thanks everyone — merging after green :tada: will follow up on #1727 with the actual fix.

sam: awesome, thanks for the fast turnaround.

alex: open a small follow-up PR for the async drain fix and add a stress test, happy to review.

marta: marking as release-blocker cleared.
